lesson: First level. Square player, lots of squares to absorb, triangles as safe filler, NO circles. Teaches movement and same-element scoring without any risk.
lore: You are Square. Grounded. Unyielding.
Triangles yield before you — safe passage, not prey.
Absorb your kin. Begin.

lesson: Corruption arrives. Adjacents are all circles. To reach the squares scattered around the board, you'll absorb circles along the way (+3 each, +1 curve). Square dies at 3 curves — pace it. Squares cleanse you back.
lore: Order corrupts at its edges.
The circles press from every direction.
Find your kin before the curves consume you.

lesson: Circle's turn. Surrounded by circles. Squares dot the corners as visible decoys — remember Circle has NO safe-transit shape; both squares and triangles add +1 straight. Death at 2 straights. This level is winnable circle-only.
lore: You are Circle. Pure. Boundless.
Your kin fill every corridor.
Reclaim them. Nothing stands between you.

lesson: Circle in hostile terrain. Adjacents are all squares (each = +1 straight). Circle dies at 2 straights, so you must absorb a circle to cleanse between every cross-element step. Strict alternation. The hardest tutorial level.
lore: The circle returns, tested.
Squares and triangles grid the world in alternation.
Navigate the pattern. Every choice is permanent.

lesson: Triangle's turn. Triangles for scoring, squares as filler. Critical new rule to memorize: Triangle absorbing Square = 0 pts, 0 corruption (SAFE TRANSIT). Squares are friends for triangles. Circles are absent here — no danger.
lore: You are Triangle. Sharp. Fractal.
Squares dissolve before you — hollow, harmless.
Walk through silence. Gather the sharp ones.

lesson: Mirror of Level 2. Triangle player. Adjacents are all circles (+3 each, +1 curve; Triangle dies at 2 curves). Triangles scattered to score and cleanse. Squares everywhere as safe transit (0/0). Tight clock — same lesson as L2 but with the elements swapped.
lore: All angles converge.
The circles press in from every side.
Stay sharp. Do not let the curves consume you.

lesson: Hexagon introduced as a single threat at the player's north. Squares now form vertical columns; triangles fill the rest. 9 squares total - barely enough for 50 if you waste any. Route around the hexagon.
lore: A new geometry has entered the grid.
One alien form. Irregular. Dangerous.
Route around it. The hexagon is not yours to take.

lesson: Second Square level. Circles surround the grid interior — each costs +1 Curve. Two hexagons gate the north corner squares. Squares act as Curve resets: absorb a circle, then quickly reach a square to recover. Never let Curves stack to 3.
lore: Two now. They multiply.
The familiar squares are still here — reach them.
Do not let the hexagons claim you.

lesson: Hexagon enters Circle's world. Adjacents are circles. Hexagon blocks the south route. Circle dies at 2 straights; cross-elements add straights. Must score 50 from circles while routing around the hexagon AND not stacking too many cross-element absorbs.
lore: You are Circle. The hexagon is death.
One cell forbidden. Absolute.
Find the path that avoids it.

lesson: Second Circle level. Adjacents are all SQUARES (+1 straight, Circle dies at 2). Two hexagons cap the north and south central columns. Player must absorb a square (gain straight), reach a circle to cleanse, navigate around hexagons. Highest tension yet.
lore: Two forbidden cells now.
The circles remain. The hexagons do not move.
Navigate the space between them.

lesson: Triangle with two hexagons on the central column (north/south poles). Circles introduced flanking the player (+3 pts / +1 curve, dies at 2 curves). Must score from triangles, may grab a circle for +3 if needed, avoid hexagons.
lore: The hexagons have entered your domain.
Touch one and it reshapes you. Cleanse immediately.
The shape beneath remembers what you are.

lesson: Final tutorial-extension. Three hexagons on corners and bottom-left, gating routes. Adjacents are circles (forced corruption). Sparse triangles (only 6) - must hit them all PLUS take circle bonuses, while routing around hexagons. Maximum tension before training wheels come off in L13.
lore: Three of them. The board has changed.
Route through the angles. Avoid the alien forms.
The balance can still be restored.

lesson: Square enters the hexagon-touched world. Four hexagons on outer cardinals — absorbable but costly. Route through squares to score, use circles as safe transit with triangles as filler. Generous paths, 14-move win.
lore: The hexagons have multiplied.
They do not pursue. They do not need to.
Find the narrow path. It still exists.

lesson: Square hard. Four hexagons form an inner ring around the player — every first move is adjacent to a hexagon. Only 12 winning paths. Absorption order is critical: score squares first, absorb hexagons only when cornered.
lore: Two forbidden forms now flank your corridor.
Square is patient. Navigate the pressure.
Every safe cell is an act of will.

lesson: Circle wakes in the hexagon realm. Four hexagons in far corners — death to Circle, never absorbed. Navigate around them, scoring circles. Triangles are safe transit (0 pts). 6-move win, 192 paths — route carefully to avoid the corners.
lore: Circle. The hexagons fill the walls.
One wrong turn and the shape dissolves.
Hold the curve. There is a way through.

lesson: Circle hard. Two hexagons top and bottom, triangle wall surrounds the player. Squares cause +1 corruption each — budget is 1. Must score from circles, route through triangles as safe transit, avoid squares. 8-move win, only 12 paths.
lore: They press from all sides now.
But the circles remain — bright, waiting.
Read the grid before you move.

lesson: Triangle enters. Four hexagons on outer cardinals — absorbable by Triangle at -3 pts each. Squares are safe transit with Triangle. Score triangles, use squares as passthrough, absorb hexagons strategically. 14-move win, 880 paths.
lore: Triangle threads the forbidden forms.
The hexagons tower but do not block all routes.
Angles find what curves and squares cannot.

lesson: Triangle finale. Four hexagons adjacent to the player — two immediately left and right, two in the inner ring. 14-move win, 976 paths. Score triangles to reach 50, absorb hexagons when they block the only exit. The chase ends here.
lore: The chase reaches its end.
Hexagons on every flank. The path is narrow.
Perform this rite and the form is sanctified.

lesson: Square meets the Moon for the first time. Two moons lurk in the NW and SE corners — death to Square. Four hexagons on cardinal axes can be absorbed. Navigate outward from the safe middle. 15-move win, 52 paths.
lore: Something new has entered the grid.
The Moon. Pale. Ancient. Lethal to Square.
Circle alone can wear its shape.

lesson: Square hard. Four moons in every corner — death. Four hexagons form the inner ring around the player. Only 8 winning paths. First move is critical: hexagon forces a costume, and the Moon closes every escape. Think before moving.
lore: Square returns, tested by the Moon.
One forbidden cell glows differently now.
Route through the familiar. Avoid the pale light.

lesson: Circle meets the Moon — the first hunter it can absorb. Two moons flank the player east and west, absorbable for -3 and a costume. Two hexagons on the north and south edges are death — avoid them. 8-move win, 76 paths.
lore: You are Circle. The Moon is yours.
Absorb it. Let it reshape you. Then cleanse.
The Moon does not kill you. It costumes you.

lesson: Circle mastery. Four moons on the diagonals — all absorbable. Two hexagons top and bottom — both death. The Moon is now Circle's weapon. 12-move win, 16 paths. The reflecting pool remembers everything.
lore: Two Moons now — one on each side.
Circle moves between them, gathering its kin.
To wear the Moon is to survive it.

lesson: Triangle enters the Moon realm. Two moons in the NW and NE corners are death — route away from them. Four hexagons adjacent to the player — absorbable by Triangle. 11-move win, 376 paths.
lore: Triangle encounters the Moon for the first time.
It is not yours to take. It kills.
Walk carefully through this pale geometry.

lesson: Triangle hard. Two moons in opposing corners — death. Four hexagons on outer cardinals — absorbable. Squares are safe transit. 17-move win, 36 paths. The actor does not turn back.
lore: The Moon commands the inner ring.
Triangle must thread between them to reach its kin.
The passage narrows. The rite demands it.

lesson: Square meets asymmetric Moon threat. Three moons block the west flank — Moon at (2,1) cuts left from the start. Hexagons on cardinals are absorbable. 17-move win, 36 paths.
lore: The Moon grows dense in the grid.
Square must navigate the pale field.
Hexagons offer costume. Moons offer death.

lesson: Square gauntlet. Every adjacent cell from the start is a Hexagon — costume is mandatory on move 1. Four Moons lock the inner diagonals. 11-move win, 8 paths. The tightest Square puzzle yet.
lore: The Moons press from every diagonal.
Square finds Hexagon as shield, not threat.
Absorb the lesser danger to survive the greater.

lesson: Circle mastery. Four Moons on inner diagonals — all absorbable by Circle. Four Hexagons in corners — all death to Circle, route wide. 11-move win, 792 paths — many valid lines.
lore: Circle in the Moon field.
The Moons are allies — wear them, cleanse, move on.
This is not survival. This is choreography.

lesson: Circle under pressure. Five Moons asymmetrically placed — near-forced Moon absorbs. Two Hexagons (top, bottom center) are death. 12-move win, 12 paths. The reflecting pool grows narrow.
lore: Six Moons. A circle of pale fire.
Circle alone moves freely through them.
The grid is a dance. Know the steps.

lesson: Triangle in the Moon realm. Four Moons guard the corners — death, avoid. Four Hexagons form the inner ring adjacent to the player — all absorbable. 11-move win, 376 paths.
lore: Triangle walks the Moon-lit path.
Four Moons stand where the kin do not.
Find the route that keeps the sharp form intact.

lesson: Triangle final trial. Four Moons lock the inner diagonals — death. Four Hexagons on outer non-corners absorb for costume. Dense triangle wall. 11-move win, 16 paths. The actor holds shape to the last.
lore: The passage ends here.
Moons and Hexagons. Every quadrant tested.
Perform this rite. The Moon no longer surprises you.

lesson: Square meets the Star. Two Stars block the N/S axis — instant death for Square. Four Hexagons absorb safely (costume), Moons wait at the flanks. Navigate the inner ring. 14-move win, 192 paths.
lore: A third geometry has entered.
The Star. It kills Square. It kills Circle.
Only Triangle can absorb it — but you are not Triangle.

lesson: Square hard. Four Stars command the corners — death on all sides. Dense Hexagon inner ring. Square must costume and cleanse while threading the narrow paths. 17-move win, 8 paths.
lore: Four Stars hold the corners.
Square must thread the inner field without touching them.
The hexagons are the lesser danger now.

lesson: Circle's first Star. One Star to the North — death. One Hexagon to the South — also death. Two Moons flank the path, offering costume and escape. A transition rite: familiar threats, new pressure. 8-move win, 76 paths.
lore: Circle meets the Star.
One to the North. Death from above.
The Moons on each side are the only salvation.

lesson: Circle hard. The Hexagon is gone — now a second Star holds the South. Stars above and below. The Moons are Circle's only allies. Same paths, pure Star theme. 8-move win, 76 paths.
lore: Two Stars now. North and South.
No Hexagon to ease the transition — only Stars.
The Moons are Circle's path through.

lesson: Triangle finds the Star. Four Stars wait at the corners — but Triangle can absorb them for costume. Four Hexagons ring the player. The hunter is finally prey. 11-move win, 376 paths.
lore: You are Triangle. The Star is yours.
Four of them wait in the corners — absorbable, not lethal.
For the first time, the hunter becomes the hunted.

lesson: Triangle hard. Four Stars press in from the diagonals — two moves away, inescapable. Hexagons guard the outer edge. Triangle hunts every Star to survive. 11-move win, 188 paths.
lore: The Stars press inward.
Triangle is surrounded by what it can consume.
Absorb every one. The form that knows its hunter is free.

lesson: Square opens the Star Journey. Two Stars, two Moons, four Hexagons — all three hunters on one board. Square survives Hexagon (costume), dies to Moon and Star. Plan the cleanse. 16-move win, 15 paths.
lore: All three hunters on one board.
Hexagon. Moon. Star. Each kills differently.
Square must learn the grammar of all three threats.

lesson: Square hard. Four Stars at corners — instant death for Square. Four Hexagons form the inner ring — costume and cleanse required. Squares anchor the cardinal edges. 17-move win, 8 paths.
lore: Four Stars at the corners. Hexagons within.
The grid is fully armed.
Square threads the only safe corridor.

lesson: Circle meets the Star. Four Stars at corners — Circle takes a Moon costume (-3) to survive. Four Moons on the inner diagonals force engagement. 11-move win, 792 paths.
lore: Circle walks the Star field.
Four Stars at the corners — death on every side.
Moons are the only passage through.

lesson: Circle hard. Stars move to N/S — blocking the axis. Shorter path, far fewer options. 8-move win, 448 paths. Tighter means harder.
lore: Two Stars. One above, one below.
Fewer deaths — but fewer paths.
The shorter route is the harder one.

lesson: Triangle finds its hunter. Two Stars flank the player — Triangle wears Star as costume (-3). Two Hexagons guard the N/S. Triangle fills the rest. 11-move win, ~7800 paths.
lore: Triangle at the threshold.
Stars flank the player. Hexagons wait beyond.
The final form approaches its final trial.

lesson: The final rite. Triangle is wholly surrounded by its absorbable hunter — four Stars on every cardinal. No Hexagon. No escape. Triangle meets its shadow head-on. The game ends here. 11-move win, ~7800 paths.
lore: This is the last rite.
Triangle, wholly surrounded by Stars.
The form that masters its hunter needs nothing more. Restore the balance.
The small field is behind you.
Stone holds its shape.
Step forward.
The corruption returns at scale.
Stone holds anyway.
What you learned remains.
Light moves before you arrive.
The watcher walks again.
What was remembered is now seen.
The moon walks among you now.
What is hollow is not yet empty.
Remember what you came to do.
The point remembers its direction.
Direction holds.
Step into the wider air.
Old names rise in the field.
The point is named again.
What you became here, you keep.
The pattern is older than you.
What kills you here is not what taught you.
Move.
Stone reads the field.
What endures, names what does not.
Hold.
What watches, hides.
What hides, gathers.
Move toward what you understand.
The pattern was always inside you.
What you absorb teaches what hunts.
Remember what cannot be touched.
The direction holds at any scale.
What is named has always been there.
Cross what cannot turn you.
The pattern closes here.
What you have become
is what was always asked of you.
Step toward the next field.
The pattern collapses inward.
What was stable burns.
Stone moves now, or stone breaks.
The lattice fractures along the line you walk.
There is no holding without movement.
Cross the break.
The watcher steps into the shadow.
What hides waits to be seen.
Look upward as you move.
What is hollow dissolves first.
What dissolves cannot remember.
Move toward what holds its name.
Light bends around what you cannot see.
Step into the curve.
The direction holds.
The pattern speaks itself at the singular point.
What was wider closes back to a name.
You are the name now. Hold.
